latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of fb-local-lead-sniper.

- Automates joining, engaging, bait posting, reply analysis, and DM outreach in Facebook local groups.
- Includes CLI tools for each step of the 5-stage lead generation funnel.
- Provides strategy guides for account warm-up, rate limits, and outreach scripting.
- Built-in templates for recommendation bait posts and personalized DMs.
- Reply analyzer identifies and ranks most-recommended local providers from group comments.
- Requires web-access skill and a CDP proxy connection to Chrome with Facebook login.
